transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’m just tired all the time. By midmorning at work, even after just going through files or helping a junior adjuster with a claim, I feel like I’m already running on empty.
Have you been feeling a persistent lack of energy or fatigue, even when you haven’t done anything physically or mentally demanding?

Yeah… that’s pretty much it. Even when I’m just reviewing files or walking a junior adjuster through a claim, by midmorning I feel like I’m already running on empty. My body and my head both just feel tired.
Does this fatigue usually go away with rest, or does it persist even after you’ve had a chance to relax or take a break?
It doesn’t really go away. I mean, I can sit down or take a break, but by midmorning I already feel drained again… like my body and my head are just running on empty.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends or family?

Yeah… most days it feels like there’s this gray film over everything. Even when my husband’s being sweet, or we’re cooking with the family, I can go through it all, but I don’t really feel much enjoyment like I used to.
Have you noticed that you feel down or hopeless most of the time, even when things are going okay in your life?

Yeah… most days, I’d say. Even when things are fine at home, it still feels kind of muted, like I’m just moving through it. My husband can be kind, or we’ll be cooking with family, and I’m there, but I don’t really feel much from it.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, even things that used to make you happy or feel good?

Yeah… I guess so. Things I used to enjoy just feel kind of flat now. I still do them sometimes, like cooking with the family, but it’s more like I’m going through the motions than actually feeling happy.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, or have you been having trouble sleeping even when you’re tired?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying close attention to my weight or anything. Sleep… I mean, some nights are better than others, but I don’t know if it’s anything specific.
Have you been sleeping more than usual, or do you find it hard to fall asleep or stay asleep even when you're tired?
I don’t really know. I mean, I get tired, but I haven’t kept track of whether I’m sleeping more or less. Some nights I’m up a bit, but… I’m not sure it’s a pattern.
Have you experienced a loss of pleasure in almost all activities, where even things you used to enjoy don’t bring you any satisfaction or happiness?

Yeah… most days it feels like there’s this gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind, or we’re cooking with the family, I can do it, but I don’t really feel the enjoyment like I used to.
Have you been feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you're not good enough or worthless?
I don’t know… I mean, I can be hard on myself sometimes, but I’m not sure it’s more than usual. “Worthless” feels like a strong word. I wouldn’t really say that.
Have you been having trouble focusing or concentrating on tasks, even simple ones, lately?

Yeah… I think so. At work I’ve been missing little details in audits, and it takes me longer to sign off on files than it should. Outside of work I’ve kind of stopped doing things like painting or hiking or volunteering… mostly I’m just trying to get through the week.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble getting yourself to do things, even simple tasks?

Yeah… I guess it’s more that I’m just tired all the time. By midmorning at work, even just going through files or explaining a claim to a junior adjuster, I feel like I’m already running on empty. Body and mind both.
Would you say that your lack of energy or feeling of being drained has been happening nearly every day for at least two weeks at a time?

Yes… pretty much. It’s been going on a while. I’m tired most days, even by midmorning at work after just reviewing files or helping someone with a claim. It feels like my body and my brain are already drained.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost pleasure in nearly all activities, to the point where nothing really feels enjoyable anymore?

I don’t know if it’s completely nothing… but most days it’s like there’s this gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind, or we’re cooking with the family, I can go through the motions, but I don’t really feel the enjoyment the way I used to.
Would you say that you’ve lost pleasure in almost all activities, to the point where very few or no activities still bring you any joy or satisfaction?

Pretty much, yes. I mean… I can still do things, like cook with my family or be with my husband, but it’s like there’s a gray film over it. I’m there, but I don’t really feel much enjoyment from it anymore.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently, such as eating much less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?
Not really… I haven’t noticed anything significant. My eating’s maybe a little off here and there, but I don’t think my weight has changed much.
Have you found it especially hard to make decisions or focus on tasks, even simple ones, most days?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get through what I need to do most days. Maybe I’m a bit slower with things sometimes, but… I haven’t really thought of it as a big problem.
Have you found it very hard to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions, even about small things, most days?
I don’t know that I’d say very hard. I mean, I have off days, but most days I can think through things well enough. Decisions can take me a bit, but… I wouldn’t say it’s a major thing.
